context.purpose: Compress and restore captured files or reusable directory selections, inspect dictionaries and frames, train reusable dictionaries, encode reference deltas, compare profile sizes and measure native throughput.
context.assumptions: Trusted configured Zstandard 1.5.7, bounded absolute regular local files, exact retained dictionaries and references. Workflows also admit digest-pinned adopted files or complete directory snapshots at their corresponding input positions.
context.constraints: 64 MiB raw, 72 MiB compressed, 128 MiB total inputs; 256 produced chunks, 4096 inspected frames, 256 MiB decoder window; no filesystem metadata preservation.
context.inspection: summary.json records freshly decoded size/SHA-256 and complete Zstandard frame metadata. Profiles publish size and observational timing; later timing authentication is explicitly false.
context.recovery: Select relevant codec/algorithm controls, retain exact dependencies, inspect stage stderr on native failure, reduce memory/output on budget refusal and rerun into a fresh directory after any verification failure.

workflow.scope: File and text artifact bindings can supply captured compression sources, dictionaries and delta references.

composition.scope: Shared document references, finite parameter studies and pure expressions resolve before planning.

lifecycle.timeout: One deadline covers version checks, compression/training and fresh verification; each native stage is capped at remaining time or 180 seconds.
lifecycle.cancellation: Shared owned process-group cancellation; no success before the final cancellation/deadline check.
lifecycle.logs: Authored/effective plans, captured input membership and bytes, stage launchers/stdout/stderr/process submissions, checked summary and verification inventory.
lifecycle.verification: Independent host frame/header/block/XXH64 inspection, actual fresh native decoding, exact byte comparison with captured sources and deterministic compression/training reconstruction.

losses: Original path metadata is not embedded in the compressed result.
data.scope: Raw source, compressed stream, dictionary, delta reference or representative sample corpus.

data.format: Zstandard, gzip, xz, lzma, lz4 or trained dictionary
losses: No original filename, permissions, ownership or timestamp preservation.
data.scope: One payload, restored byte file, trained dictionary or finite comparison candidates.

losses: Compression does not infer character encoding or preserve the original text publication name.
data.scope: A workflow text artifact can supply source, dictionary/reference history or a sample; its actual encoded file bytes are captured.

inspection.scope: Checked decoded byte count and hash, complete Zstandard frame metadata and comparison sizes.
inspection.limits: Other codec internals are read by the trusted native decoder; historical elapsed timing is observational.

authoring.reuse: Edit named controls or source bytes to invalidate reuse; keep captured dependencies with their parent run.

workflow.scope: File and text artifact bindings can supply captured compression sources, dictionaries and delta references.

composition.scope: Shared document references, finite parameter studies and pure expressions resolve before planning.

reusable-inputs.scope: Exact source, dictionary, reference and sample byte digests participate in reuse identity.

source-authoring.scope: Editable JSON documents with shared validation, undo and source editing.

property-authoring.scope: Twelve named Studio task starters and typed controls, including file sets, nested tuning, adaptive bounds and profile lists.

conversion.scope: Lossless codec conversion can compose restoration with compression; each side proves decoded content.

native-save.scope: Compressed payloads and trained dictionaries are durable native-format files and reopen in fresh native processes.

native-inspection.scope: No persistent interactive native application; checked JSON frame and content observations use the text viewer.

mpi.scope: The Zstandard CLI is a bounded shared-memory compressor; no MPI command is exposed.

time-batches.scope: File-set tasks capture multiple named or recursively selected files. The compressor has no native time axis; ordinary workflow studies supply finite parameter states.

live-editing.scope: The CLI has no persistent application document. Edit intent and rerun into a new publication directory.

cases.scope: Exact authored literal fixture bytes, independently counted and hashed; fresh native decoding and host frame/checksum inspection must agree.

completion.scope: Accepted twelve stable CLI content tasks and their nested finite controls, captured file/directory handoffs and complete product delivery. Whole-inventory review and integrated acceptance are recorded in the dated verification note; this is local engineering acceptance, not public release approval.

notApplicable.native-inspection: A command-line compressor has no persistent interactive document; checked frame, dictionary and content observations are text publications.
notApplicable.mpi: The stable Zstandard CLI has shared-memory workers and no native MPI interface. The existing process scheduler owns independent jobs.
notApplicable.time-batches: The file codec has no native time axis. Captured file sets and finite workflow studies supply multiple input states.
notApplicable.live-editing: There is no persistent native application document or reverse-edit protocol. Edit declarative intent and rerun into a fresh directory.
